marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots increasing to southeast 20 late this
evening and to southeast 30 late overnight except southeast 35 over southeastern
sections Friday. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2
after midnight and to 2 to 3 early Friday morning.<br/>
